title: How Intel Lost the Chip Crown
summary: In 2021, Intel kept almost $20 billion of profit. In 2024, it lost almost $19 billion. Today TSMC sells more than twice as much, and the US government owns about a tenth of Intel. The full timeline: the iPhone chip Intel passed on, the factory delays that let TSMC, AMD and Apple pull ahead, the AI wave that went to Nvidia, Pat Gelsinger's factory bet and its $30 billion of losses, the rescue by Washington, SoftBank and Nvidia, and where Intel stands now.
